_readme: The ONLY place to change the Hong Kong DNC hotline key presses and pause lengths (MPC-7450). Edit values here; no code change needed. status: UNVERIFIED = placeholder/guess, REPORTED = one person heard it on one call, VERIFIED = confirmed on a real call by someone who understood the menu in that language. Set IVR_VERIFIED=true in hkDnc.ts only when every key is VERIFIED (a unit test enforces this). Sequence pressed: language, menu (register a number), register choice, confirm. Procedure: docs/hk-dnc-ivr-procedure.md.

pauses._note: Each unit is one comma, about 2 seconds on Android. Chris heard about 10-12 s of greeting before the language menu. UNVERIFIED.

language._note: Language menu as reported by Chris 2026-10-11: 1 Cantonese, 2 Putonghua (Mandarin, unused by us), 3 English.

menu._note: Main menu: 1 = register a number (reported by Chris).

registers._note: Each register: [register-choice key, confirm key]. Chris heard 3 options after 'register': 1 'do not call', 2 'do not call, long message', 3 'do not call, short message'. Which is pre-recorded / SMS / fax / all is a GUESS (needs a trilingual speaker). Confirm key is a GUESS. Fax has no key heard yet.
